        assert t not in yesterday_set and tw > 0
    elif act == "ADD":
        assert t in yesterday_set and tw > holdings[t]["tradable_weight"]
    elif act == "TRIM":
        assert t in yesterday_set and 0 < tw < holdings[t]["tradable_weight"]
    elif act == "SELL_ALL":
        assert t in yesterday_set and tw == 0.0
    assert len(d["risk_check"]) <= 300

for nt in no_trade_decisions:
    assert len(nt["reason"]) <= 300

# Check final holdings count and weight sum
active_dec_weights = sum(d["target_weight"] for d in decisions if d["target_weight"] > 0)
nt_weights = sum(holdings[d["ticker"]]["tradable_weight"] for d in no_trade_decisions)
tot_w = active_dec_weights + nt_weights
active_count = sum(1 for d in decisions if d["target_weight"] > 0) + len(no_trade_decisions)
print(f"All assertions passed! Active count={active_count}, Total weight={tot_w:.6f}, Est cash={1-tot_w:.6f}")
